TestScyllaARestApi::test_basic_rest_upti.description: Single node. Reads GET /system/uptime_ms, sleeps 10s, reads again; asserts the uptime delta lies between 9990ms and the wall-clock time measured around both requests + 10ms. Guards that the REST uptime counter advances in real time (used by nodetool info).

origin.summary: Added 3 uptime REST tests (basic, after restart, compare nodes).

commits.afdad9630e: bounds changed to [sleep-10ms, measured wall time+10ms] after undershoot failure
commits.c7410e39f8: lower bound < changed to <= (exactly 10000ms seen on fast machine)
commits.fa6b692a1b: port to pytest: single_node mark, debug -> logger.debug
commits.b866c65bce: request_uptime helper uses node.api_port instead of hardcoded 10000

TestScyllaARestApi::test_basic_rest_upti.relevance: Live: /system/uptime_ms in api/api-doc/system.json:111, used by tools/scylla-nodetool.cc:1379 (nodetool info).

duplicates.note: only checks HTTP status, not value
mocked REST server, tests nodetool formatting only

TestScyllaARestApi::test_basic_rest_upti.reason: Only test checking the uptime value actually advances in real time; scylla tests only check status (test/rest_api/test_system.py::test_system_uptime_ms) or mock it. Cheap (~15s), 100% pass after bound fixes afdad9630e/c7410e39f8.

TestScyllaARestApi::test_rest_uptime_aft.description: Single node started, sleep 10s, node stopped and restarted; asserts uptime_ms after restart < (total elapsed since test start - 10s), i.e. uptime was reset by restart and not carried over. Guards that uptime is per-process.

commits.51d3c29ee0: formatting (assert message split into two f-strings); commit mainly adds test_drop_row_cache
commits.b866c65bce: request_uptime helper uses node.api_port instead of hardcoded 10000

TestScyllaARestApi::test_rest_uptime_aft.reason: Unique check that uptime resets on restart; no scylla test checks the value. Cheap (~19s), 100% pass. Assertion is loose (uptime < elapsed-10s) but meaningful.

issues.text: Loose bound (uptime < elapsed - 10s); still catches uptime not being reset on restart.

TestScyllaARestApi::test_compare_node_up.description: Two nodes started, sleep 10s, node1 restarted; asserts node2 uptime - node1 uptime > 10000ms. Same restart-resets-uptime scenario as test_rest_uptime_after_restart, plus implicit check that restarting node1 does not affect node2's uptime.

commits.51d3c29ee0: formatting (assert message split into two f-strings)
commits.b866c65bce: request_uptime helper uses node.api_port instead of hardcoded 10000

duplicates.note: same restart-resets-uptime assertion on 1 node; uptime is a per-process local value so node2 independence adds little

TestScyllaARestApi::test_compare_node_up.reason: Mostly redundant with test_rest_uptime_after_restart in the same file (both assert uptime resets after restart); extra node only checks that uptime is per-node, which is trivially true (local process clock). Candidate to drop or merge; cheap (~22s).

TestScyllaARestApi::test_drop_row_cache.description: Single node, c-s write+read 50K rows to populate cache, scrape Prometheus metrics, POST /system/drop_sstable_caches, scrape again; asserts cache miss/eviction counters did not decrease and cache rows/partitions/LSA usage did not increase. Added for scylla 761f89e55e (api: Introduce system/drop_sstable_caches).

commits.72809f2380: formatting (list concat -> unpacking in stress cmd)
commits.b866c65bce: drop_row_cache helper uses node.api_port instead of hardcoded 10000

TestScyllaARestApi::test_drop_row_cache.relevance: Live: /system/drop_sstable_caches (api/column_family.cc:1166) -> database::drop_caches (replica/database.cc:1827) invalidates row cache + sstable caches. Metrics still exist (db/row_cache.cc:161-176, utils/logalloc.cc:2870,2888).

duplicates.note: asserts data is in row-cache before and only in sstable after POST /system/drop_sstable_caches - direct, stronger check

TestScyllaARestApi::test_drop_row_cache.reason: Assertions can't detect a no-op drop: increase_metrics are counters (db/row_cache.cc:161,163,176) so `>=` always holds, and `<=` on gauges also holds if nothing changed (rest_api_tests.py:107-111); POST status not checked (drop_row_cache helper). Scylla's test/cqlpy/test_select_from_mutation_fragments.py::test_mutation_source directly verifies cache is emptied by the same endpoint. Bug: get_metrics (rest_api_tests.py:64) overwrites per-shard values, so only the last shard's sample is compared. Note: scylla_lsa_memory_allocated is a counter (utils/logalloc.cc:2888) asserted to 'decrease'; metric_class param unused.

issues.text: Counters asserted `>=` always hold and gauges `<=` hold if unchanged; a no-op cache drop passes.
drop_row_cache helper doesn't check the POST status.
get_metrics overwrites per-shard values; only the last shard's sample is compared.
scylla_lsa_memory_allocated is a counter but asserted to decrease.
